plans.objective: [DIM: structure] The thermal expansion coefficient of ZrW2O7 exhibits negative values due to rigid unit modes (RUMs) in its cubic pyrochlore structure, where the solution space of atomic positions is constrained by corner-sharing polyhedra to allow specific low-energy vibrational modes.

steps.description: Implement the `family` function for the rigid polynomial family as required by the capacity_scan workflow. The function must return normalized training/evaluation dictionaries for both rigid (low-dimensional solution space) and fat (high-dimensional) families, adhering to all shape, normalization, and held-out constraints specified in the protocol. This is a code implementation task to enable the subsequent machine learning experiment.
